description: This file defines the WorkspaceSubscriber class, which implements event handling for workspace publish events in Drupal. It checks whether a workspace can be published based on moderation states of tracked revisions, preventing publication if there are revisions in non-default moderation states.

classes.name: WorkspaceSubscriber
classes.description: Event subscriber class that manages pre-publish checks for workspaces, ensuring they are in appropriate moderation states before allowing publication.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting entity type manager and optional workspace tracker services.

methods.name: onWorkspacePrePublish
methods.description: Event handler that prevents publishing of a workspace if it contains revisions in non-default moderation states.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this class subscribes to, specifically the WorkspacePrePublishEvent.
